newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EESTI KINDLUSTUS AUDITED PROFIT 26.3 MLN EEK.
newsitem.headline: EESTI KINDLUSTUS AUDITED PROFIT 26.3 MLN EEK.

text.p: Eesti Kindlustus, the largest insurance company in Estonia and a subsidiary of Hoiupank, said on Monday its 1996 audited net profit was 26.3 million kroons versus a loss of 2.2 million kroons in 1995.
The company's non-life insurance subsidiary, Eesti Varakindlustus, posted a net profit of 37.4 million kroons in 1996, the company said in a statement.
It said it had a net profit of 10.2 million kroons in the first quarter of this year including profit from finance investments of 6.5 million kroons.
Eesti Kindlustus' unaudited net profit was 25.6 million kroons in 1995 and it said the smaller 1996 profit was due to a loss in its life-insurance subsidiary, Eesti Elukindlustus.
It said that Elukindlustus was the market leader in the life-insurance market but has many old and small insurance agreements, which are very costly for the company.
The company's balance sheet was 128.8 million kroons and equity 39.7 million kroons in 1996. Eesti Varakindlustus assets were 128.6 and equity 58.1 million kroons.
The balance sheet grew 13 percent from the beginning of the year to 145.4 million kroons and equity by 26 percent to 49.9 million kroons.
Eesti Varakindlustus assets fell by 2.8 million kroons in the first quarter to 126 million kroons. Equity rose by 19 percent to 69 million kroons.
Eesti Kindlustus was privatized last year by Hoiupank, Hansa Investments, Finland's Profit OY and Estonian Pindi Vaartpaberid.
